description: The ranked lists ETFIQ publishes, or one of them. Each ranks one published number inside a stated set, such as the cheapest funds in a theme or buffer funds closest to their cap. No argument lists them.

limit.description: Most rankings to list when slug is omitted. Default 40, at most 400.

slug.description: Optional: one ranking's slug, to read that ranking. Omit to list the published rankings.

name: etf_rankings

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
